title: Correctness: DO_KDF pad-fail leaves IKM in inbuf
description: Trigger: (1) open fd, (2) write(fd, ikm_bytes, N) to accumulate IKM in inbuf, (3) ioctl(fd, DO_KDF, op) where op._pad contains non-zero bytes (or any pre-lock validation fails after the ikm_fd block). The goto out_early / out_zero path returns -EINVAL without acquiring state->lock and without calling inbuf_clear(). Result: IKM key material persists in state->inbuf. (4) User calls write(fd, key_bytes, M) — appends to existing inbuf; inbuf_len is now N+M. (5) User calls ioctl(fd, KEY_IMPORT, op) with op.keylen == N+M — the import succeeds but the imported key material is the old IKM concatenated with the new key bytes, not the intended key. FIPS 140-3 violation: CSP not zeroized when no longer needed. Fix: acquire state->lock and call inbuf_clear() before returning on all pre-lock failure paths in ioctl_do_kdf, or restructure so inbuf_clear() is called unconditionally at out_zero.
close_reason: out_early now acquires state->lock and calls inbuf_clear before falling to out_zero; ikm_fd fget failures changed from goto out_zero to goto out_early
